question: Can same-local-day other-runway public taxi count/sum observations reduce uncertainty in peers contributing to the target assigned-day departure-delay total?

novelty.finding: Genuinely untested in reviewed code/history. Existing methods use only the target runway taxi cell. Calendar variant adds departure-day coordinates; one/all-discrete peers and EP change inference without adding other-runway observations.

control.coordinates: A=(target local-day/runway taxi count, taxi sum, target assigned-UTC-day departure-delay sum).
control.target: Retain exact existing finite support and weights; subtract its moments once from A. Its extra-observation vector is exactly zero.
control.likelihood: Original 3D t5 with scale=.6*C_AA and original leave-one-out mean. Exact same input gates, calendars, source calibration and support.

bounded_observation_set.selection: All other supported runway cells on the target local takeoff day that contain at least one member of its assigned-day delay cohort; deterministic runway ordering.
bounded_observation_set.support: Apply the unchanged taxi support, quality, coverage-ratio and minimum-count conditions. No target/label/posterior selection.
bounded_observation_set.full_cell: An included runway observation retains ALL of its original taxi members, including those assigned to other departure days. Intersection with the delay cohort only establishes a connection; it must not truncate source membership.
bounded_observation_set.bound: At most two coordinates per published airport runway for this one local day, plus the one delay coordinate. No recursive neighboring-day/month graph.

covariance.projection: For each flight j, P_j embeds its original 3-vector into its unique runway taxi block and, if assigned to target delay day and in delay scope, the delay coordinate. Sum P_j Cov(g_j) P_j^T and projected means over the union, excluding target once.
covariance.cross_flight: Distinct flights remain independent under the retained prior-moment model. Shared flights induce each runway-delay cross covariance. Disjoint runway taxi blocks have zero peer covariance.
covariance.measurement: Keep each retained taxi 2x2 source-noise block and the one retained departure variance exactly; no duplicate source observation or noise term. Additional off-diagonal calibrated measurement errors are currently unknown.
covariance.common15: Use ONE 225*l*l^T for the entire bounded message: l=(0,n_target,-loading_delay,0,n_other1,...). n is the original expected valid-taxi count and loading_delay is original sum normal P(gap-Y>0) for gap<=3600. The original three-coordinate marginal remains exactly unchanged. Do not add an independent 15s factor for every runway-delay pair.

likelihood_objection.strongest: A naive (3+2R)-dimensional t5 creates a common latent precision for all observations. Even an added covariance-disconnected cell then changes target evidence, contrary to a claimed peer-information-only mechanism. Marginalizing extras recovers the old 3D t5, but conditioning on them does not ignore disconnected cells.
likelihood_objection.bounded_option: Gaussian Schur condition the original A moment approximation on B, then evaluate the unchanged 3D t5: K=C_AB C_BB^-1; mu_A_given_B=mu_A+K*(observed_B-mu_B); C_A_given_B=C_AA-K*C_BA.
likelihood_objection.exact_recovery: No B coordinates, or C_AB exactly zero, recovers old 3D mean/covariance/posterior regardless of observed B residual. All old 3D submatrices must reproduce before conditioning.
likelihood_objection.honesty: This is a hybrid Gaussian-moment conditioning approximation followed by a robust t5 message, not exact conditioning of a larger Student distribution. No new transfer coefficient is proposed here.

remaining_strong_objection: Cross-runway source reporting errors are not calibrated. Shared airport omission or runway reassignment can correlate taxi count/sum errors positively or negatively beyond the retained common15 factor. Treating the extra measurement blocks as otherwise independent may yield overconfident or biased corrections. Existing v70/v77 source-informed predictions also make this an incremental approximation, not independent new data.

one_source_only_opportunity_test.scope: Use only existing 26,528-row label-free joint-public packet, fixed source tables/parameters and original touched-cell metadata. No departure labels, CV scores, fits or raw data downloads.
outputs: Eligible other-runway-cell coverage and runway-count distribution for every original touched cohort/target.
Fraction of delay peer variance belonging to members with an included other-runway observation.
Schur delay-variance reduction and eigenvalues/trace of standardized original-3D covariance reduction.
Standardized induced 3D mean shift from actual extra-source innovations; standardized covariance condition numbers.
Separate diagnostic decomposition of cross covariance from actual shared flights versus common15 only; no alternate prediction arm.
Extra-source Mahalanobis residuals and their dimension, retained as leverage/overconfidence diagnostics, never gates.
invariants: Exact old 3D covariance/mean and posterior replay when extra coordinates disabled.
Synthetic disconnected extra observation has exactly no effect under proposed hybrid conditioning.
All full augmented covariances and Schur complements positive definite without floors.
Permutation invariance, no target membership in extra runway cells, and explicit local-day versus assigned-day distinctions.
one_source_only_opportunity_test.interpretation: This can establish usable additional covariance/observation information or reject negligible coverage/contraction. It cannot estimate seconds of RMSE gain. Stop before target posterior changes or held scoring pending root review.
one_source_only_opportunity_test.selection: Exactly six cohorts per month, twelve total, at evenly spaced integer positions in the lexicographically sorted distinct original (local_day,runway,assigned_day) touched-cell list; choose before reading added-source residuals. If a month has fewer than six cohorts, retain all and report the count.
one_source_only_opportunity_test.moments: Reuse unchanged original support function and parameters; generate moments only for the selected unions. No changed support design, prior calibration or source-noise fit.

execution: Only source/report reads and this design receipt. No model implementation, data scan, inference or scoring.
comparison_note: If later inference is authorized, preserve original departure-only comparator. Added-observation effect is conditioned joint minus original joint. Conditioning departure-only on extra taxi cells would subtract part of the newly added evidence and is a different question.
independent_peer_review: model_diversity agrees novelty and Schur hybrid coherence; emphasizes one common15 outer product and unchanged departure-only comparator.
